about.intro: We are GoHarv.®, an interdisciplinary business ecosystem designed to support companies, entrepreneurs and leaders in their processes of organization, professionalization, growth and expansion, in a personalized and strategic way.
about.expand1: We integrate strategic consulting, business development, executive training, risk prevention and compliance solutions, connecting companies with specialized professionals, businesses with businesses (B2B) and entrepreneurs with investors, incorporating applied technology —including Artificial Intelligence— to drive strategic, secure and sustainable decision-making.
about.expand2: All our work is structured under an ethical, structured and scalable standard, designed for today's business world: real, complex and ever-changing contexts.
about.expand3: We do not operate as a traditional service provider. At GoHarv.® we act as strategic partners of your company, getting involved in key decision-making, execution and the consolidation of results that directly impact the business.

que.title: WHAT IS GoHarv.?
que.card1: A strategic hub that connects companies with specialized professionals under a common logic.
que.card2: A bridge between entrepreneurs and investors, facilitating real development and expansion opportunities.
que.card3: A platform for integrated corporate solutions, not fragmented ones.
que.card4: A business ecosystem designed to organize, professionalize and scale organizations.
que.card5: A business model that incorporates technology and artificial intelligence to optimize processes.
que.text1: Each business unit of GoHarv.® follows a shared logic: organize, professionalize and grow organizations.
que.text2: We know the business world from the inside. We are entrepreneurs and professionals who operate in real contexts, and that is why we design effective, applicable, executable and lasting solutions.

noES.title: What GoHarv.® is NOT
noES.1: A generic consulting firm that sells diagnostics without execution.
noES.2: A traditional office of professionals from different disciplines working in isolation.
noES.3: A services marketplace without criteria or strategic responsibility.
noES.4: A provider that delivers reports and walks away.

historia.title: OUR STORY
historia.p1: GoHarv.® was born from a concrete need in the business world: to integrate knowledge, services and technology under a unique strategic vision.
historia.p2: For years, companies solved their challenges in a fragmented way: one advisor on one side, a provider on another, training disconnected from administrative management and critical decisions made without structured information.
historia.p3: GoHarv.® emerges to break that logic, creating a disruptive business ecosystem where areas communicate, enhance each other and generate real impact, with clear rules, method and long-term vision.
historia.p4: We work on four central pillars that support our way of doing things, which we call the GoHarv.® METHOD:

metodo.title: THE GoHarv.® METHOD
metodo.subtitle: Order, strategy and execution to grow businesses.
metodo.p1: At GoHarv.® we work with our own method, developed from real professional experience in companies, organizations, processes and complex challenges.
metodo.p2: We don't improvise solutions. We don't apply generic recipes. We design, implement and accompany improvement processes with strategic, technical and ethical criteria.
metodo.p3: Taylor Made. We understand that each company requires a unique, personalized strategy. A true tailor-made suit.
metodo.p4: Our methodology represents our way of doing things, and it is what makes us different. It is not a slogan, it is the operational and cultural method under which the entire GoHarv.® ecosystem works.
metodo.p5: It represents a concrete way of thinking, deciding and executing.
metodo.p6: The GoHarv.® method is the intersection between strategic thinking, intelligent business design and professional responsibility. It represents a work system, a way of doing things, one hundred percent traceable, auditable and scalable.
metodo.p7: Our method arises from real experience + professional direction + legal-business criteria.
metodo.principios.title: Guiding Principles
metodo.p1.title: Think differently, but with criteria
metodo.p1.desc: Inspired by Steve Jobs' vision, we believe that real innovation does not arise from noise, but from clarity. Simplifying the complex, questioning the given and designing solutions that have strategic and functional sense.
metodo.p2.title: Excellence as minimum standard
metodo.p2.desc: We don't look for "good enough". Every service, process or delivery must meet a high, consistent and replicable professional standard.
metodo.p3.title: Operational ethics
metodo.p3.desc: Doing things right, even when no one is watching, is not a moral slogan: it is a sustainable competitive advantage.
metodo.p4.title: Strategy + execution
metodo.p4.desc: Ideas without implementation generate no value. The GoHarv.® method integrates strategic vision with concrete and measurable execution.
metodo.p5.title: Conscious business design
metodo.p5.desc: Just as a well-designed product improves the user experience, a well-designed company improves its results, reputation and continuity.
metodo.como.title: How do we work?
metodo.e1.title: Comprehensive business diagnosis
metodo.e1.p: We analyze the company as a system. If we don't know the business, it would be impossible to apply our method's solutions.
metodo.e1.li1: We survey key processes: Commercial, Operational, Administrative, Financial, Legal, HR and Technological.
metodo.e1.li2: We evaluate the maturity level of each process.
metodo.e1.li3: We detect deviations, inefficiencies, risks and improvement opportunities.
metodo.e1.li4: We develop risk matrices and operational matrices.
metodo.e1.entregable: 📄 Deliverable: General diagnostic report, risk and process map.
metodo.e2.title: Definition of strategic objectives
metodo.e2.li1: We understand the client's business and context.
metodo.e2.li2: We define concrete and achievable objectives.
metodo.e2.li3: We relate each objective to specific processes to improve.
metodo.e2.li4: We prioritize impact, feasibility and urgency.
metodo.e2.highlight: 🧠 GoHarv.® Methodology enhanced by the strategic Canvas method applied to the real business.
metodo.e3.title: Design of comprehensive improvements by process
metodo.e3.p: Each process is worked on specifically. We analyze and propose improvements in:
metodo.e3.li3: Technology → available tools, adoption level, possible automation.
metodo.e3.li4: Methodology → GoHarv.® Method + Business Model Canvas (Alexander Osterwalder).
metodo.e4.title: Standardization, control and continuous improvement
metodo.e4.li3: We create control and monitoring mechanisms.
metodo.e4.li4: We leave installed capacity in the organization.
metodo.e4.entregable: 📄 We provide training based on documented procedures, indicators, flowcharts and operational standards.
metodo.e5.title: Implementation and accompaniment stage
metodo.e5.p: We don't deliver a report and disappear.
metodo.e5.li1: We build concrete action plans and execute them.
metodo.e5.li2: We assign responsible parties and deadlines.
metodo.e5.li3: We implement proprietary technology (whistleblowing channel) or tracking boards (Kanban / Trello / ClickUp).
metodo.e5.entregable: 📄 Deliverable: We develop the OPERATIONAL MANUAL for your company, with the executed action plan and documented processes.
metodo.manual.title: The Operational Manual
metodo.manual.p1: The OPERATIONAL MANUAL represents the know-how of your Company, your way of doing things, your successful and proven method.
metodo.manual.p2: It will allow you to SCALE your business, making it replicable, EXPAND your brand and your company through the development of a Franchise or License system, through third parties (investors), allowing growth and expanding your presence in new markets without having to directly finance all the infrastructure.
metodo.franquicia.text: 👉 Want to know how to franchise your business or brand?

pablo.intro1: Dr. Pablo N. Cacciatore is Co-Founder and a member of the senior management of GoHarv.®.
pablo.intro2: As Chief Legal Officer, he combines legal vision with business strategy to mitigate risk and ensure regulatory compliance, thereby safeguarding the interests and assets of companies.
pablo.intro3: As an entrepreneur and corporate lawyer, he leads litigation strategy in complex cases and in dispute resolution within business contexts of high economic impact.
pablo.form4det: He holds several certificates and diplomas attesting to his training and professional development, obtained at institutions such as the Universidad de Buenos Aires (UBA), the CPACF Graduate School and the UNLZ, among other entities of recognised academic prestige.
pablo.memb3: Membresía: Asociación Argentina de Productores Asesores de Seguros
pablo.ejec1: With more than 20 years in professional practice, Dr. Pablo Nicolás Cacciatore has a solid track record as counsel and attorney-in-fact for companies in complex litigation.
pablo.ejec2: He specialises in estates and succession planning for the continuity of family businesses, as well as in property insurance and damages claims.
pablo.ejec3: His training as a Mediator enables him to take part in highly complex negotiations, applying alternative dispute resolution methods in sensitive scenarios of high economic impact.
pablo.ejec4: He has extensive experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts for companies.
pablo.ejec5: He is the Founder of the full-service law firm Cacciatore & Asociados, through which he has advised individuals and companies from a range of sectors for more than two decades across multiple areas of law —Civil, Commercial, Labour, Criminal, Family and Succession.
pablo.ejec6: He also served as Legal Advisor to the National Ministry of Security of the Argentine Republic, taking part in inter-agency investigations alongside federal forces.
pablo.goharv1: He leads the legal vertical, coordinating the network of legal advisors and contributing legal strategy and litigation experience across jurisdictions, with an approach based on risk prevention and governance in business transformation processes.
pablo.goharv2: He takes an active part in the development of the GoHarv.® ecosystem, supporting business owners, business families and boards through critical processes of transformation, continuity and expansion.
pablo.premio1: GoHarv.®, nominee for the WIPO Global Awards 2026 (World Intellectual Property Organization), a specialised agency of the United Nations System founded in 1967 – Category: Emerging company – Geneva, Switzerland.
pablo.cta: If your organisation faces challenges related to business continuity, succession in family businesses, legal risk management or complex dispute resolution, you can count on the advice of our team.

alejandro.form2det: He holds several certificates and diplomas obtained at institutions such as the Universidad de Buenos Aires (UBA), the Consejo Profesional de Ciencias Económicas de la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires (CPCE), the Universidad Kennedy (UK) and HSBC Bank Argentina, among other entities of recognised academic prestige.

eduardo.intro1: Eduardo Rovito is Co-Founder and a member of the senior management of GoHarv.®.
eduardo.intro2: As Chief Business Development Officer (CBDO), he drives the creation and development of new business, promoting new corporate models that are disruptive and sustainable, and generating strategic opportunities within the GoHarv.® ecosystem.
eduardo.intro3: His profile as a businessman gives him an approach that combines business vision, the architecture of new ventures, disruptive innovation and execution capacity to design, validate and scale business models across multiple industries and sectors.
eduardo.ejec1: With more than 30 years as an entrepreneur, Eduardo Rovito is the Founder and CEO of Cerrajería Leonardo®, a leading company in Access Control and security solutions for residential buildings, founded in the City of Buenos Aires in 1994. The company has a solid market presence and a scalable business model that gave rise to its franchise system, forming the first franchise network of intelligent access control systems, digital locks and home automation for condominium associations and real estate trusts in Argentina.
eduardo.ejec2: He is the creator of the Cerrajería Leonardo® Franchise System, consolidating an expansion model based on operational efficiency, standardisation and territorial development.
eduardo.ejec3: Cerrajería Leonardo® is not only a leader in the City of Buenos Aires: it has also been the pioneering company in technological innovation applied to access control in Argentina, incorporating equipment that meets international standards.
eduardo.ejec4: To that end it works with technology from the prestigious company HID Global®, part of the ASSA ABLOY® group, a world leader in secure identity and access control solutions, with a prominent operational presence in ports, universities, large companies and airports around the world.
eduardo.ejec5: In addition, since 2019 Eduardo has developed and led, together with the legal team of Cerrajería Leonardo®, the creation of a compendium of legal documents based on its business model, known as the “Pack de Legales”. It comprises a range of instruments (loan-for-use and service agreements for condominium associations and trusts, internal policies, internal protocols for specific cases, disclaimers, legal notices, legal wording, website compliance, a legal section and a series of commercial contracts geared towards strategic expansion) which together have demonstrably and successfully reduced claims and disputes, bringing litigation down to zero. This has driven the optimisation of internal processes and resources while reducing operating costs and widening the business's profit margins.
eduardo.ejec6: The aforementioned “Pack de Legales” is part of the intangible assets that, as from 2026, Cerrajería Leonardo® makes available to companies in the digital and electronic locksmith and access control sector in the City of Buenos Aires market.
eduardo.ejec7: Cerrajería Leonardo® currently serves more than 1,300 active condominium associations, over 50,000 residential units and more than 250,000 end users who rely on its know-how, products and services every day.
eduardo.ejec8: Cerrajería Leonardo® represents the evolution of the traditional locksmith service into an intelligent ecosystem of access control, security and technology management for buildings.
eduardo.ejec9: With a consolidated track record, strategic partners, international technology alliances and a clear vision of the future, the company continues to lead the transformation of the sector in Argentina.
eduardo.innov1: Eduardo is also Co-Founder and CEO of Acceso 1®, a technology startup focused on developing solutions and automation for the access control, electronic, biometric and digital locksmith sector.
eduardo.innov2: The software is also compatible with any company providing services to condominium associations, condominiums, buildings, gated communities, country clubs, garages, car parks and real estate trusts, such as providers of lift and building hoist services, cleaning, security and pest control, among others.
eduardo.innov3: Within Acceso 1®, Eduardo was instrumental in the creation and development of the following assets:
eduardo.innov4: Eduardo is currently leading the strategic expansion of Cerrajería Leonardo® 2026, about to open new franchised branches at key locations in the City of Buenos Aires, with a view to expanding into strategic areas across the country -Mar del Plata, San Carlos de Bariloche, Santa Fe, Rosario, Mendoza, Córdoba and La Plata-, before assessing the international expansion of the brand.
eduardo.innov5: He also leads the expansion strategy of Acceso 1® into new market segments, while working with his partners on the roadmap for upcoming technology developments.
eduardo.innov6: His notable career as an Argentine entrepreneur is characterised by the creation of disruptive business models, the development of scalable products and the negotiation of commercial agreements under B2B, B2C and B2B2C schemes.
eduardo.innov7: Throughout his career he has challenged traditional structures through constant innovation, the incorporation of technology —including artificial intelligence— and solutions with high operational and commercial impact.
eduardo.goharv1: At GoHarv.®, he leads the development of new business models, the identification of strategic opportunities, the creation of scalable structures and the generation of alliances, taking an active part in business expansion processes that can be replicated across any segment and industry. Eduardo is a strategist when it comes to business expansion.
